Christmas in “When Harry Met Sally...” 🎄❤️

There’s something so comforting about watching When Harry Met Sally… (1989), especially during the holiday season.

Directed by Rob Reiner and written by Nora Ephron, it remains one of the most honest, charming, and relatable romantic comedies ever made. Billy Crystal and Meg Ryan have incredible chemistry, making even the simplest conversations feel memorable.

The film captures New York beautifully throughout the changing seasons, from colorful autumn leaves in Central Park to Christmas trees, snowy streets, cozy apartments, and New Year’s Eve celebrations. There’s a warmth and nostalgia to it that makes you want to revisit it every year.

Beyond the romance, it’s a film about friendship, timing, growing older, and realizing how much someone means to you. Its iconic New Year’s Eve scene remains one of the most romantic moments in movie history.

It may not technically be a Christmas movie, but it’s easily one of the best films to watch during Christmas and New Year’s.
